records.notes: Drupal site (server-rendered, no WP/JS framework — platform enum has no 'drupal', closest is static_html). Listing at /events with pagination ?page=0..2 (~12 event teasers per page, dates Sept 2026–Jan 2027 visible). Detail pages carry dates, £ fees (e.g. £0 members / £20), venue and register links directly. Evening Medical Updates are hybrid (in-person Edinburgh + online + catch-up viewing) — watch for the on-demand/catch-up wording. PACES prep, Acute Medicine Updates and Online Education not seen on page 1; may appear on later pages or a separate education section.

CMS is Preside (ColdFusion-based), fully server-rendered. The single listing page contains ~506 unique /event/*.html links (past + upcoming mixed; ~186 refs to 2026, 18 to 2027) with dated cards (day badge + month) and CPD credits inline; sample event page shows dates, CPD credits, description and Book Now on the page itself. The worklist 'expect' names are training programmes (Histopathology/Chemical Pathology/etc.), which live under /profession/training.html as curricula, not dated events — none appeared on the events listing; the events are symposia, webinars and CPD-approved courses instead.

records.notes: Drupal 10 server-rendered search listing at /events combining events (/news-events/events/*) and courses/webinars (/education-careers/courses/rcpch-course|rcpch-webinar/*); paginated ?page=0..2, dated cards (e.g. 07 October 2026). Detail pages carry the date on-page but the sample event showed no GBP fees inline (some events are free/virtual; fees may need per-course checking). RSS feed exists at /rss/events.xml which could serve as a cheap change-detection source.

expected_found: Cataract Surgery Complications (as CATS / cataract surgery skills incl. posterior capsule management)
records.notes: WordPress listing is a single accordion page: each course block gives title, location, description and multiple dated sessions in D/M/YY format (e.g. 5/10/26), each linking to a booking page on the iMIS registrar at ihub.rcophth.ac.uk (Event_Display.aspx?EventKey=...). iHub detail pages are server-rendered ASP.NET (VIEWSTATE) and carry the full date and fees (£498/£595 seen) without JS; ~15 EventKey links visible. Basic Phaco / Microsurgical Skills not on this page — simulation skills courses live under /training/simulation/skills-courses/. Also links an iHub Event_Search.aspx portal and an annual-congress subpage.

Platform is Drupal 10 + Commerce (not WordPress — closest enum used). /training-courses is a hub linking ~25 course-type pages (e.g. /training-courses/adult-life-support/als-2-day-course-advanced-life-support); each course page server-renders a Drupal Views 'course_availability' table with dated upcoming sessions (Start date, Course centre, town, organiser contact, availability), paginated via ?page=0..N (~15 pages x 5 rows for ALS). Fees are set locally by each Course Centre — no per-session price on site (RCUK charges centre £31.57/candidate); booking is by contacting the organiser directly, not online.

Marketing site www.rcsed.ac.uk/events-courses is a landing page; the real catalogue lives on the services.rcsed.ac.uk subdomain (custom CMS, server-rendered, no wp-content) paginated via ?page=1..5 (~15 items/page). Detail pages (/events-courses/<slug>/) carry dated sessions, fees (multiple GBP tiers) and booking on the page itself; mix of conferences/symposia and repeated skills courses with multiple sessions per course page.

Drupal 11 server-rendered site; listing paginates via /education?&page=N (pages 1..11, ~10 cards/page, dated cards). Detail pages at /education/{slug} carry fees (member/non-member GBP), venue, and multiple session dates selectable via ?selected_date=YYYY-MM-DD — good fit for course_sessions model. Booking redirects to community.rcpsg.ac.uk/event/book/... (external registrar for booking only, not needed for scraping).

records.notes: Server-rendered CMS (Sitecore-style calendar): ~73 upcoming dated events all on one page at /events/conferences, detail URLs encode the date (/events/conferences/detail/YYYY/MM/DD/default-calendar/slug). Fees (£), venue and dates are on the detail page; booking redirects to member.rcpsych.ac.uk Salesforce event-booking (event IDs a3D...). Mix of conferences, courses and webinars; some entries marked [CANCELLED] — filter those. EventsAir is only referenced for FAQs, not the listing.

Server-rendered listing at /events-courses-exams/ with dated cards (e.g. "3rd Sep 2026") and query-param pagination ?pageSize=12&pageIndex=N (2 pages currently, ~12 upcoming events incl. Scottish Public Health Conference 2026 and Public Mental Health Conference 2026). Detail pages carry date, fee and register links directly. Not WordPress (no wp-content); custom CMS. Past events archived at /past-events-courses-exams/. Diplomate exam prep and specialty training live under /training-careers/ as static info pages, not dated events.

records.parked_reason: E-learning platform only (WordPress + LearnDash): ~1013 on-demand CPD modules under /modules/, no dated events or bookable course sessions. /events and /courses return 404; no Tribe API. RCEM dated events are on rcem.ac.uk (already sources 6/7/8).
records.notes: Pure on-demand e-learning catalogue behind optional login; expected names exist only as undated modules. Do not onboard; dated RCEM events already covered via rcem.ac.uk sources 6/7/8.

WordPress site with custom /event/ post type (Tribe API 404s). Listing has a date-range filter form and currently shows only one upcoming event (MRO workshops, 04/02/2026-08/10/2026, CPD 5.5/6); detail page carries dates + CPD points server-rendered, registration via external "View Event Website" link. Very low volume; many listed items are externally-approved CPD events, and there is also an "External events" section. None of the expected course names (MFOM exam prep, OM training etc.) appear as dated events — those live under static /education pages.

records.notes: Main site is a Moodle VLE, but course dates live on a plain server-rendered PHP page at /coursedates/courseview.php?coursetype=<TYPE> with 14 types (APEx, APLS 2 Day, APLS Recertification, ATLS, CPRR, CYP APEx, HMIMMS, HMIMMS Team Provider, MIMMS 2 Day, MIMMS Team Provider, mMOET, NAPSTaR, PLS, POET — enumerate all in a loop; no PHTLS, ATLS instead). Each table row carries start/end dates (DD-MM-YYYY), venue, fee (e.g. "Course Fee £715.00") and booking note inline; APLS 2 Day alone shows ~60 upcoming sessions. Optional location/startdate POST filters exist but GET with coursetype suffices.

records.parked_reason: FSEM is a CPD-accrediting faculty, not an event organiser. Events page (WordPress static blocks, no Tribe API — /wp-json/tribe/... 404s) shows only a past webinar recording, exam entries linking to exam-info pages, and one already-past external event (Therapy Expo Nov 2025 on therapyexpo.co.uk). No upcoming dated FSEM events or bookable courses; none of the expected course names (SEM Training, MSK Ultrasound, Exercise Medicine, Sports Injury courses) appear — those are run by third parties that FSEM merely accredits.
records.notes: If ever revisited, the only structured dated content is the Exams Calendar at /careers-and-training/exams/exams-calendar/ (exam sittings, not conferences/courses). External SEM events would come from BASEM (basem.co.uk), which FSEM links to — consider that as the actual source for the expected course names.

Server-rendered corporate CMS (Optimizely-like, not WordPress). /events/congresses/ lists ~11 congresses (ESC Congress 2026, Heart Failure 2027, EHRA 2026/2027, EAPCI 2027, EACVI 2026, ACNAP 2027, etc.) with dated cards; also /events/specialised-events/ and /education/live-events/courses/ exist for extra volume. Each congress is a microsite with subpages for registration/fees/programme, so detail extraction needs to follow subpages under the congress path. Given HFA start URL was a community page; the real listing is site-wide /events/.

Custom WordPress theme (not Tribe — /wp-json/tribe/... 404s). Listing at /events/ renders static server-side <article class="post-... events"> cards with title, date (e.g. "Thursday 20 August 2026"), time and Online/venue category badge; card links go to /event/<slug>/ detail pages which carry a "Booking Information" section with GBP fees on-page (£350/£375/£450 member tiers). Pagination via /events/page/2/ (6 cards p1, 4 p2). Mix of the FPM Annual Conference 2026 (24 Nov 2026, featured), DPM Training Programme exam-revision course modules (MCQ/SAQ/CAP), and free webinars (Women in Clinical Trials, ABPI Code Case Notes). Skip non-event cards like "FPM Sponsorship Opportunities" and "FPM On Demand" under /events/ slugs.

Platform is iMIS Cloud (ASI/Telerik .aspx, tenant COSRH — this org is the rebranded FSRH). The /Public/Events list is rendered client-side by an iMIS iPart, so Playwright is required; raw curl returns only header/footer. 10 upcoming dated events visible (Sep–Dec 2026), mix of conferences (CoSRH Conference 2026 Manchester, Trainer Conference, Scotland women's health) and courses/webinars (Menopause Care course, DCSRH assessments, Postpartum Contraception Training). Details live on per-event pages at /Public/Event_Display.aspx?EventKey=XXXX. The REST endpoint /api/Event exists but returns 401 anonymously (iMIS token auth would be needed). Diploma/Letters of Competence (IUT/SDI) are qualifications, not listed as dated events. Type filter dropdown exists; no pagination observed with 10 items.

records.notes: Custom ASP.NET CMS (generator "lmsitestarterduke", moduleevents) — not WordPress despite .org.uk look; /wp-json redirects to .aspx. Server-rendered year-grouped listing at /events with month rows and dated links (/events/{id}/{slug}); navigate years via /events/date/2027 and filter Annual Meetings via /events?type=1103. Listing is an aggregator-style community calendar: many third-party/predatory-looking nursing congresses mixed in with genuine ACPGBI/coloproctology courses and chapter meetings — filter by type or title. Detail pages carry fees/booking info on-page (e.g. "No registration fee").

Main site is a static Webflow build; /event-type/asgbi-congress cards carry name, date range and venue in HTML server-side (e.g. Congress 2026, 12-14 May 2026, DoubleTree Brighton; Congress 2027, 21-23 May 2027, Manchester Central). A sibling listing /event-type/egs-symposium exists (EGS Symposium events). Detail/registration ("Learn More") links go to events.asgbi.org.uk, an Angular SPA event portal (noindex, empty-body, JS-required, module URLs like /asgbievents/modules/263011/html) — scrape core fields from the Webflow listing and treat the portal only as the outbound registration URL; fees would need JS rendering of the portal.

Drupal (not WordPress — 'wordpress_other' used as closest enum; platform is Drupal) behind a Cloudflare managed challenge: curl and WebFetch get 403/challenge, but headless Playwright loads fine, so js_required is really 'browser required'. Listing at /events with ?page=0..3 (~10 cards/page, dates + city + CPD credits on cards); the worklist URL /events-professional-development 404s. Detail pages have Overview/Programme/Pricing tabs — fees live on the Pricing tab, not the overview. Mix of conferences, revision courses, webinars, study days; 'Anaesthetic Updates' (Sep + Oct 2026) confirmed, Airway is a filter category (category_id param, e.g. category_id=1791).

Drupal site fully behind an aggressive Cloudflare interactive challenge: curl, WebFetch and even headless Chromium all get 'Just a moment' 403; only HEADED Chromium (headless=False, --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, ~10-30s wait) passed, so GitHub Actions scraping will need a stealth/solver approach. Real listing is /events (NOT /eventslisting, which renders nav only) — server-rendered dated cards (e.g. '17 August 2026 | 8:00am-17:00pm'), 9 events on page 0 with ?page=1 pager, filters for Date/Location/Category (many items flagged 'External Event'), detail pages at /events/[slug]. Saw FFICM/FCICM exam-prep courses and ultrasound (FAMUS/FUSIC, echo) events; no ICM Annual Meeting visible on page 1.
